summary.from: La Española con blancas: presión duradera sobre el caballo que defiende e5, enroque rápido y centro con c3 y d4. Las ramas cubren las defensas más habituales de las negras.
summary.to: The Ruy Lopez with White: lasting pressure on the knight that defends e5, quick castling and a centre built with c3 and d4. The branches cover Black’s most common defences.

steps.0.note.from: Un peón al centro: abre camino al alfil y a la dama.
steps.0.note.to: A pawn to the centre: it opens the way for the bishop and the queen.

steps.1.note.from: Las negras también reclaman el centro.

steps.2.note.from: Desarrollas atacando el peón de e5.
steps.2.note.to: You develop, attacking the pawn on e5.

steps.3.note.from: Las negras lo defienden con el caballo.
steps.3.note.to: Black defends it with the knight.

steps.4.note.from: La Española: el alfil presiona al caballo que defiende e5.
steps.4.note.to: The Ruy Lopez: the bishop puts pressure on the knight that defends e5.

steps.5.note.from: Las negras preguntan al alfil qué piensa hacer.
steps.5.note.to: Black asks the bishop what it intends to do.

steps.5.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: Las negras contraatacan e4 en lugar de echar al alfil.
steps.5.branches.0.steps.0.note.to: Black counter-attacks e4 instead of chasing the bishop away.

steps.5.branches.0.steps.1.note.from: Defiendes e4 con calma y evitas el final que surge tras 4.0-0 Cxe4.
steps.5.branches.0.steps.1.note.to: You calmly defend e4 and avoid the endgame that arises after 4.O-O Nxe4.

steps.5.branches.0.steps.2.note.from: El alfil negro sale a su mejor diagonal.
steps.5.branches.0.steps.2.note.to: The black bishop comes out to its best diagonal.

steps.5.branches.0.steps.3.note.from: Preparas d4 y das una casilla de retirada al alfil.
steps.5.branches.0.steps.3.note.to: You prepare d4 and give the bishop a retreat square.

steps.5.branches.0.steps.7.note.to: You prevent ...Bg4, which would pin your knight.

steps.5.branches.0.steps.8.note.to: Now they do challenge the bishop.

steps.5.branches.0.steps.9.note.from: Conservas el alfil y la presión sobre c6.
steps.5.branches.0.steps.9.note.to: You keep the bishop and the pressure on c6.

steps.6.note.from: Te retiras sin cambiar: mantienes la presión sobre el caballo.
steps.6.note.to: You retreat without exchanging: you keep the pressure on the knight.

steps.7.note.from: Las negras desarrollan y atacan e4.

steps.8.note.from: Enrocas y dejas e4 como cebo: si lo toman, recuperas con la torre en e1.
steps.8.note.to: You castle and leave e4 as bait: if they take it, you win it back with the rook on e1.

steps.9.note.from: Las negras desarrollan con calma: es la variante Cerrada.
steps.9.note.to: Black develops calmly: this is the Closed Variation.

steps.9.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: Las negras aceptan el peón de e4.

steps.9.branches.0.steps.1.note.from: Abres el centro de inmediato, con el rey negro aún sin enrocar.
steps.9.branches.0.steps.1.note.to: You open the centre straight away, with the black king still uncastled.

steps.9.branches.0.steps.2.note.from: Las negras echan al alfil antes de nada.
steps.9.branches.0.steps.2.note.to: Black chases the bishop away first.

steps.9.branches.0.steps.3.note.from: El alfil apunta a d5 y f7.
steps.9.branches.0.steps.3.note.to: The bishop aims at d5 and f7.

steps.9.branches.0.steps.4.note.from: Las negras sostienen su caballo con un peón.
steps.9.branches.0.steps.4.note.to: Black supports their knight with a pawn.

steps.9.branches.0.steps.5.note.from: Recuperas el peón y ganas espacio.
steps.9.branches.0.steps.5.note.to: You win the pawn back and gain space.

steps.9.branches.0.steps.7.note.from: Das al alfil una casilla de retirada en c2.
steps.9.branches.0.steps.7.note.to: You give the bishop a retreat square on c2.

steps.9.branches.0.steps.8.note.from: Las negras desarrollan y preparan el enroque.
steps.9.branches.0.steps.8.note.to: Black develops and prepares to castle.

steps.9.branches.0.steps.9.note.from: Desarrollas y atacas al caballo de e4.
steps.9.branches.0.steps.9.note.to: You develop and attack the knight on e4.

steps.9.branches.0.steps.11.note.from: El alfil apunta al enroque negro.
steps.9.branches.0.steps.11.note.to: The bishop aims at Black’s castled king.

steps.10.note.from: La torre defiende e4 y vuelve a amenazar ganar e5.
steps.10.note.to: The rook defends e4 and once again threatens to win e5.

steps.11.note.from: Las negras echan al alfil para liberar a su caballo.
steps.11.note.to: Black chases the bishop away to free their knight.

steps.12.note.from: El alfil se coloca en la diagonal que mira a f7.
steps.12.note.to: The bishop settles on the diagonal aiming at f7.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: Las negras enrocan antes de jugar ...d6.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.2.note.from: El Gambito Marshall: las negras dan un peón para atacar tu rey.
steps.13.branches.0.steps.2.note.to: The Marshall Attack: Black gives up a pawn to attack your king.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.4.note.from: Las negras recuperan con el caballo.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.7.note.from: La torre recupera: tienes un peón de más, pero vienen a por tu rey.
steps.13.branches.0.steps.7.note.to: The rook recaptures: you are a pawn up, but they are coming for your king.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.8.note.from: Las negras sostienen su caballo y preparan ...Ad6.
steps.13.branches.0.steps.8.note.to: Black supports their knight and prepares ...Bd6.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.9.note.from: Desarrollas el alfil de c1 y controlas e5.
steps.13.branches.0.steps.9.note.to: You develop the c1 bishop and control e5.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.10.note.from: El alfil echa a la torre y apunta a h2.
steps.13.branches.0.steps.10.note.to: The bishop drives the rook away and aims at h2.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.12.note.from: La dama negra amenaza mate en h2.
steps.13.branches.0.steps.12.note.to: The black queen threatens mate on h2.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.13.note.from: Cierras el paso a la dama.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.14.note.from: La dama se instala junto a tu rey.
steps.13.branches.0.steps.14.note.to: The queen settles next to your king.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.15.note.from: Desarrollas y tapas la columna e.
steps.13.branches.0.steps.15.note.to: You develop and block the e-file.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.16.note.to: Another black piece joins the attack.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.17.note.from: La dama defiende y prepara Cd2 y Af1.
steps.13.branches.0.steps.17.note.to: The queen defends and prepares Nd2 and Bf1.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.18.note.from: Las negras traen la última torre.
steps.13.branches.0.steps.18.note.to: Black brings in the last rook.

steps.13.branches.0.steps.19.note.from: Desarrollas el caballo: el peón de más compensa la presión.
steps.13.branches.0.steps.19.note.to: You develop the knight: the extra pawn makes up for the pressure.

steps.14.note.from: Preparas d4 y das al alfil una casilla en c2.
steps.14.note.to: You prepare d4 and give the bishop a square on c2.

steps.15.note.from: Las negras ponen el rey a salvo.
steps.15.note.to: Black puts the king in safety.

steps.17.note.from: La defensa Chigorin: el caballo echa a tu alfil.
steps.17.note.to: The Chigorin Defence: the knight chases your bishop away.

steps.17.branches.0.steps.0.note.from: El caballo vuelve para ir a d7 y dejar libre el peón de c.
steps.17.branches.0.steps.0.note.to: The knight goes back to head for d7 and free the c-pawn.

steps.17.branches.0.steps.3.note.from: Tu caballo va camino de f1 y g3.
steps.17.branches.0.steps.3.note.to: Your knight is on its way to f1 and g3.

steps.17.branches.0.steps.4.note.to: The bishop puts pressure on e4.

steps.17.branches.0.steps.5.note.to: You defend e4 a second time.

steps.17.branches.0.steps.6.note.from: Las negras preparan ...Af8 para defender su rey.
steps.17.branches.0.steps.6.note.to: Black prepares ...Bf8 to defend their king.

steps.17.branches.0.steps.7.note.to: The knight continues on its way.

steps.17.branches.0.steps.8.note.to: The bishop defends the castled king.

steps.17.branches.0.steps.9.note.from: El caballo llega a g3, mirando a f5.
steps.17.branches.0.steps.9.note.to: The knight reaches g3, eyeing f5.

steps.18.note.from: El alfil se retira y sigue defendiendo e4.
steps.18.note.to: The bishop retreats and keeps defending e4.

steps.19.note.from: Las negras ganan espacio en el flanco de dama.
steps.19.note.to: Black gains space on the queenside.

steps.20.note.from: Ahora sí: el centro con dos peones.
steps.20.note.to: Now is the time: the centre with two pawns.

steps.22.note.from: El caballo irá a f1 y g3, como en tantas líneas de la Española.
steps.22.note.to: The knight will go to f1 and g3, as in so many Ruy Lopez lines.
